sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents and how LangGraph enables reliable multi-step agent workflows. Highlighted real production use cases where agents handle complex developer tasks autonomously.

sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder @ Latent.Space | AI Engineer
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on the current state of AI infrastructure, focusing on inference optimization and cost-effective scaling for agentic systems. Emphasized open-source tooling that developers are adopting rapidly.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI Researcher & Creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Posted about new automation patterns using LLMs for code generation and testing. Covered practical examples of how developers are integrating AI agents into CI/CD pipelines.

sources.author: Clem Delangue
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ Hugging Face
sources.post_summary: Talked about the latest AI infrastructure advancements including new model hosting capabilities and tools that simplify deploying agents at scale for engineering teams.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Ramp | Ex-Salesforce
sources.post_summary: Explains how GTM engineering teams are replacing traditional outbound SDR motions with automated intent signals and AI-driven sequences. Highlights a 3x lift in reply rates after implementing dynamic lead scoring tied directly to product usage data.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Shares a framework for aligning content strategy with revenue operations by mapping each content asset to specific funnel stages and pipeline impact. Details how his team uses attribution modeling to prioritize which content pieces actually move deals forward.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Founder @ OutboundOS | GTM Advisor
sources.post_summary: Breaks down how modern outbound automation stacks combine enrichment, sequencing, and deliverability monitoring into a single workflow. Warns against over-automation without human oversight and shares metrics from teams seeing 40%+ reply rates with tighter personalization.

sources.author: David Kwon
sources.headline: VP Revenue Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Discusses the evolution of sales ops into revenue operations, emphasizing unified data models across marketing, sales, and CS. Provides examples of how his team reduced CAC payback period by 22% through tighter GTM and content alignment.

sources.author: Arpit Mohan
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ SuperTokens | Ex-Amazon
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey of pivoting from a corporate role at Amazon to building an open-source auth infrastructure startup. Highlighted the challenges of going solo initially, the first 100 paying customers milestone, and lessons on validating ideas before full-time commitment.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder @ Headlime & 2X Exit | Indie Maker
sources.post_summary: Posted about launching a new AI writing tool in 6 weeks as a solo founder. Broke down the tech stack, customer acquisition via Twitter/LinkedIn, and revenue numbers from the first month. Emphasized the importance of shipping fast over perfection.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Founder @ Rowy | Previously Google
sources.post_summary: Detailed his transition from Google to building an open-source Airtable alternative. Shared weekly updates on product development, hiring challenges as a solo founder, and how community contributions accelerated feature releases.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder @ Nomad List & Remote OK | Indie Maker
sources.post_summary: Posted a transparent update on his latest micro-SaaS launch, including user growth metrics, tech decisions made in a weekend, and the realities of maintaining multiple products solo. Focused on the mindset of consistent small releases.

sources.author: Sankalp Jauhari
sources.headline: Software Engineer → Founder @ CommandBar
sources.post_summary: Wrote about leaving his engineering role to build a devtool startup. Covered the emotional aspects of the career pivot, early user interviews conducted while still employed, and how he validated demand before quitting.
